# Comic Strip Canvas

## About
Comic Strip Canvas is a UK-based pop culture wall art brand creating bold, vibrant comic-book style canvas prints, framed prints, and posters. All products are made to order using premium materials (260gsm photo paper for posters, 410gsm water-resistant canvas for canvas prints).

## Contact
- Email: contact@comicstripcanvas.co.uk

## Products
We offer three distinct art styles:
- Comic Book Covers: Dramatic, vintage-inspired comic book cover designs featuring Film, Music, and Sporting legends
- Comic Book Icons: Bold pop-art graphic portraits with powerful quotes and vivid colour
- Comic Book Strips: Multi-panel sequential storytelling artworks capturing iconic moments

All styles available as:
- Poster Prints (260gsm): Small £9.99, Medium £12.99, Large £16.99
- Canvas Standard Frame (410gsm, 18mm): Small £26.99, Medium £31.99, Large £44.99
- Canvas Gallery Frame (410gsm, 38mm): Small £28.99, Medium £33.99, Large £46.99

Sizes: Small 12x8", Medium 18x12", Large 24x16"
UK shipping £4.95 on orders under £50, free on orders of £50 and over. One price anywhere in the UK.

## Personalised Service
Customers can upload their own photos to create personalised comic art in any of our three styles. Personalisation fee: £10 for any style (Cover, Icon or Strip), on top of the print price. Customers arrange their photos in the on-site builder; the finished artwork is emailed for approval, usually within one working day, and nothing is printed until they approve it.

## Key Information
- Website: https://comicstripcanvas.co.uk
- Location: United Kingdom
- Dispatch: 3-6 working days (personalised: from proof approval), then 1-2 working days tracked UK delivery. One price UK-wide: £4.95, free on orders of £50 and over
- Returns: standard (non-personalised) prints can be returned within 14 days of delivery for a change of mind (customer pays return postage); personalised items are made to order and are not returnable unless faulty. Faulty or damaged items: replacement or full refund, return postage covered. Full policy: https://comicstripcanvas.co.uk/refund-policy/
- New subscribers get 10% off their first order
- Made to order
- All artwork created in-house
- Proof approval process for personalised orders
